targets.outcome_quote: An attempt was made to replicate and extend Levin and Isen's (1975) "Feeling good and helping" experiment. Con trary to their findings, those subjects who found a dime did not mail an apparently lost letter more often than did those who did not find a dime. These results were obtained in three different settings.
